Welcome to a VirtualTour of Benin Medical Care Hospital (BMC), Located at the hearth of Benin Cityof Edo State, Nigeria. Benin Medical Care was commissioned on the 1st Day ofNovember 2019 by his Excellency Mr. Godwin Nogheghase Obaseki, Governor of EdoState, To the Glory of God and benefit of humanity. BMC offers full range ofmedical care and it is committed to addressing health challenges of Nigeriansthrough cutting edge technology and patient-centric approaches. The Hospitaloffers a whole array of medical services which includes:


Emergency Services

Medical Imaging

Orthopaedics

Laboratory Services

Nephrology

Paediatrics

Cardiology

Obstetrics and Gynaecology

Pharmacy

Dental Service

Oncology

Urology

Family Medicine

Ophthalmology

Internal Medicine

 

Geriatrics

DR. OMATIGA ACHIMUGU GABRIEL 


A graduate of medicine and surgery from the university ofIbadan (2005). Got his fellowship of the National Post-graduate College ofNigeria 2016 and master degree in Biomedical Engineering UK (2018).


Have been practicing as a Clinical Radiologist since 2016 andmostly works as Consultant Radiologist


He is currently the head of Diagnostics at Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State.

DR. EVAWERE PATIENCE AKPODIKERE


She is an adept paediatrician with 13 solid years of medical practice experience including 8 years of dedicated child health specialization and practice.

She had her undergraduate medical education in the University of Benin School of Medicine in 2007 and subsequently obtained the post-graduate fellowship of the West Africa College of Physicians.

She honed her skills in effective communication with patients, their relatives and other medical professionals in her management team. This enables easy flow of information that culminates in good patient outcomes. She is also a very detail oriented professional; this makes her patients to be assured of a wholistic care.

Her work experience includes her houseman-ship at Central Hospital Warri from 2007 -2008, where she perfected her skills in bedside procedures. Between May 2008 – June 2009. She went for her National Youth Service and served as an NYSC Doctor at the medical reception station of the Mambila barracks of the Nigerian Army. She later went on to serve as a medical officer in the Institute of Human Virology July 2009, where she worked with pregnant women in the PMTCT Clinic (Prevention of Mother to Child Transmission of HIV). This later transitioned her in working for the University of Benin Teaching Hospital in the same capacity from October 2009 – 2012.

However, she had always nursed a passion for child health, and had passed the primaries required for commencing specialist, therefore, immediately she got placement, she proceeded to do her specialization in paediatrics which was completed in 2019.

At the end of her residency programme while awaiting her dissertation presentation she did a few locum paediatrician job at St. Philomena Hospitals, Lily Hospitals Limited Benin and the Women Health and Action Research Centre attending to paediatric inpatients and outpatients.

When she is not practicing medicine, she enjoys experimenting with various recipes, she also enjoys watching thought provoking movies.

She is married with 3 lovely children.

She is currently a Consultant Paediatrician at Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State.

DR. TOLU GIWA-SOWANDE


Dr. Tolu Giwa-Sowande has always been passionate about caring for people and solving human medical problems since she was a little girl. This influenced her choiceof studying Medicine and Surgery at the University of Ibadan where she graduated 8 years ago with the M.B.;B.S. degree.


She also holds a Masters in Public Health degree from the University of Liverpool and has different professional certifications including Basic Life Support, Leadership and Management in Health amongst others.


She is astrong team player, hardworking, dedicated and a go-getter. She is known for her patience, dedication and attention to detail for each individual patient case. She loves to treat her patients with utmost kindness and ensure they getthe best care at all times.


She is agreat public speaker and enjoys cooking, reading and traveling.


Her major interests include women health and lifestyle medicine. She hopes to continue to use her medical skills to in order to further the cause of medicine, helping to improve patient outcomes and encourage the next generation of physicians.


She is currently a Medical Officer at Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State.

DR. OMOJOYE  FAYOWOLE .I.


Dr. Omojoye Fayowole .l. is a dedicated Christian, an ardent sport fan and a strong lover of the political world that is deeply passionate about the sick; he loves to make people smile/laugh no matter their health challenge(s) because he believes it is a good therapy for fast and complete recovery. 


He is a general practitioner that graduated from Igbinedion University Okada, 2012. He did his Internship at University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital, Choba and was privileged to do his NYSC at Area Command Nsukka Police Clinic, Enugu State. He did his secondary education at Delta Careers College, Warri.


Furthermore, he held many leadership positions while in school and during NYSC because of his good managerial skills, he has been involved with series of medical outreach and he has worked in some private hospitals in Nsukka, Benin andWarri.


He is currently a general practitioner in Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State.

DR. IGBINOVIA IKPONMWOSA SHERIFAT

Dr. Igbinovia Ikponmwonsa Sherifat finished from Igbinedion University Okada in2015. The role of a doctor has been one of her passion since childhood and being one, is one of the most fulfilling job she could have undertaken.


She is hardworking, passionate and enthusiastic about her job. She loves to meet the need of her patients in any little way she can, and nothing gives her joy than to see her patients recover fully.


She is a team player, always striving to achieve the highest standard possible at any given task or in any situation. She has acquired a lot of skills on the job and she is still in the process of learning.


Her hobbies are dancing, reading and baking and she loves good gist too.


She is hoping to be a psychiatrist soon enough because she believes mental health is a vital part of a man and its importance should not be ignored.


She is currently a Medical Officer at BeninMedical Care, Benin City, Edo State.

DR. OSAHON ERIC OGEDEGBE


Dr. Osahon Eric Ogedegbe is a medical graduate of the University of Benin (M.B.B.S) and did his medical internship at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital (UBTH) before National Service in 2000.

Certified by the International SOS Johannesburg Training Center, South Africa in keeping with the curriculum of the American Heart Association and American College of Surgeons, he is a provider of advanced cardiovascular, advanced trauma, international trauma and pediatric advanced life support and instructor.

Prior to joining BMC with his expertise, he worked as an emergency physician with International SOS, the world’s leading provider of medical services in the Oil and Gas Industry while also providing occupational health services from 2014 to 2019.

His experience also cuts into the government health sector having worked with Kogi and Bayelsa State Hospitals Management Board, rising to Chief Medical Officer and was in charge of several secondary health institutions on different occasions. He has exposure within and outside Nigeria, from West Africa, South Africa to Singapore.

An advocate of high value care, evidence-based medicine, clinical excellence and best practices, he has a deep sense of dedication and commitment to duty with “emergency preparedness” as his mantra and demonstrates the will and the skill to deliver optimal care.

When not working, reading, music and quality family time are his hobbies. He is married with three adorable Kids.

He is presently head of the accident and emergency department at Benin Medical Care (BMC).

DR. BENJAMIN O. UHUNMWANGHO 


Dr. Benjamin O. Uhunmwangho (MB;BS, MPH, MWACS) is a graduate of the prestigious University of Benin, Benin City (UNIBEN), where he obtained his medical degree (MB;BS) and then proceeded to obtain a Master of Public Health (MPH) in the same University. 

Having worked few years with one of the foremost HMO’s in the country where he garnered experience on its operations, he began his specialty programme in the department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, University of Benin Teaching Hospital (UBTH) where he obtained his membership in both National Post-graduate Medical College of Nigeria (NPMCN) and West African College of Surgeons (WACS).

He brings his wealth of experience to play in his professional endeavors and he sees no limitations when his mind is determined to achieve. He is married with adorable kids.

He is currently a Senior Medical Officer (Obstetrics and Gynaecology) at Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State.

DR. OSEYOMON OKAIWELE


Dr. Oseyomon Okaiwele graduated from the university of Benin, Benin City with a Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MB.BS) in 2009.

After his mandatory internship and National Youth Service, the desire for self-improvement led him to undergo post-graduate specialization at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital. He completed a fellowship of the National Post-graduate Medical College of Nigeria in Obstetrics and Gynaecology in 2017.

He is currently a Consultant Obstetrician/Gynaecologist at Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State. Description:

DR. ORDIA RAPHAEL EVUARHERHE MBBS, FWACP-FM, Cert LMH

A trained physician in the provision of continuous, comprehensive and coordinated care across all ages and specialties with exceptional doctor patient relationship.

He obtained his MBBS from the Prestigious University of Benin, Benin City and had his post-graduate training in Family Medicine in the University of Benin Teaching Hospital.

He was formerly the Head of Department of Family Medical/Primary care in Lily Hospitals Limited Warri, where he was involved in the training of resident doctors in Family Medicine and was also the coordinator of internship programme.

Currently, he is the Head Clinicals and Acting Chief Executive Officer of Benin Medical Care, Benin City, Edo State.
